verdict.rationale: Docusign documents built-in AI features. AI-Assisted Review offers an AI-powered chat that reviews agreements, flags risky language, suggests edits and drafts new language, and it references ready-to-deploy agents and playbooks. Signers also get AI summaries and Q&A, and CLM can draft clauses on demand. However, these are scoped review, drafting and suggestion features, not a general assistant you hand multi-step product tasks to; the agentic workflow actions shown come through external agents via MCP rather than an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that executes delegated actions (e.g. preparing and sending envelopes or running workflows), detail on what the 'agents' actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
